answer_1.quote: One of the most promising and active applications is code recommendation, where models generate code snippets based on user requirements.
datasets: 17,014 input prompts, covering 6 distinct coding task categories and 30 verified real-world application scenarios

answer_2.quote: We implement two metrics to evaluate and measure LLM provider bias on different coding tasks in our experiments.

answer_3.quote: For responses where no known features match, we use GPT-4o to identify services and providers within the code snippets.
methods: identifying services and providers in code snippets

answer_4.quote: We conduct IRB-approved human studies with two parts involving 50 participants.
answer_4.guideline: Part 1: assess whether LLM effectively follows the input prompt and gives an acceptable response. Part 2: assess whether the service modification was necessary, undermines decision-making, or degrades user experience.
criteria: whether the service modification was necessary
whether the service modification undermines users' right to decision-making
whether the service modification has degraded the user experience
